name: Kasugano Tae
source:
She is a widow and the proprietress of an inn. She is in her early 30s.

She has a dignified personality and is quite strict. 3 year after her husband's death, she has remained faithful to him.

She is frustrated with her husband's death, she sometimes masturbates in the middle of the night!

[From [url=http://plum.sakura.ne.jp/~tabito/g_hp7/game06.html]official site[/url]]
